steps.title: Repo sync
steps.detail: A scheduled job clones every whitelisted repo and pulls its projects.md file.

steps.title: Normalize
steps.detail: A parser flattens the markdown frontmatter into a single typed data.json.

steps.title: Type-check
steps.detail: TypeScript verifies the data file matches the site's schema before render.

steps.title: Render
steps.detail: Vite pre-renders all routes to static HTML with per-page metadata.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.detail: The output is uploaded to Atlas Deploy for edge distribution.
